notes.title: Psikodelya 1.0.11 is live!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

Psikodelya [b]1.0.11[/b] is live!

[b]The most solid version of the game so far!
All reported bugs have been fixed.[/b]

[b]Let's keep the psychedelic machine running![/b]

Check out this patch's Changelog for further details:

[code]
====================================== v1.0.11 ========================================

1.0.11 Changelog


+++ Improvements
* [spoiler]Added fireflies in the planet C20H25N3O[/spoiler];
* General Performance Improvements.

+++ Bug Fixes
* Fixed Achievement 100% progress not popping;
* [spoiler]Fixed Float Mushroom in the planet C20H25N3O[/spoiler];
* Fixed some missing colliders;
* Minor Fixes.
[/code]


Remember that you can help us find bugs/issues!

email us (infinitygreen.studios@gmail.com)
Twitter @Psikodelya

[b]
Happy Trippy! [/b]

tags.bug: * [spoiler]Fixed Float Mushroom in the planet C20H25N3O[/spoiler]
